description: A bright, airy primary bedroom with a pronounced vaulted ceiling. The entire room is painted crisp white — walls, ceiling, and the steeply pitched gable that rises to a peak above the bed. A large tufted upholstered bed with a grid-button cream linen headboard sits centered against the back wall, dressed in white linen bedding layered with forest green velvet accent pillows, a multicolor subtle stripe bolster, and a thick white duvet. Two matching painted dark black ribbed chest nightstands with small brass hardware flank the bed, each topped with simple styling — one holds two stacked books and a small potted herb. At the foot of the bed sits a low white upholstered bench and a woven seagrass rectangular natural bench with walnut trestle legs. A faded grey-blue area rug covers the light hardwood floor. The room is bathed in cool diffuse natural light from both windows. The mood is effortless, fresh, and quietly elegant.
